moments.title: Love Island 2026 crowned its winners!
moments.blurb: Lorenzo Alessi and Julia Majchrzak were crowned the winners of Love Island 2026 in last night's live final, taking home the £50,000 prize after eight weeks of villa drama.

angles.name: Winners Revealed
angles.copy: And then there were two! Huge congratulations to Lorenzo and Julia, your Love Island 2026 winners! What a journey it's been. #LoveIsland

angles.name: Aftermath Buzz
angles.copy: Still processing last night's Love Island final? The villa drama might be over, but the debates are just beginning! Who was your favourite couple?

angles.name: The Debrief Tonight
angles.copy: Didn't get enough Love Island? The Debrief returns tonight at 10pm on ITV2 and ITVX to chew over all the final villa gossip. Get ready for some hot takes!

moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 in full swing
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are currently underway in Glasgow, Scotland, running from July 23rd to August 2nd, featuring athletes from 74 nations competing in 10 sports across four venues.

angles.name: Glasgow Excitement
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are lighting up the city until August 2nd. What's been your favourite moment so far from the action across Scotland?

angles.name: Mid-Games Update
angles.copy: We're halfway through the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! Who are you rooting for in the final few days of competition? Tune in for all the latest from the multi-sport event.

angles.name: Team Nations
angles.copy: From thrilling athletics to powerful swimming, the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are delivering. Which Commonwealth nation are you championing?

moments.title: Scotland's Summer Bank Holiday next week
moments.blurb: While England, Wales, and Northern Ireland await their August Bank Holiday at the end of the month, Scotland celebrates its Summer Bank Holiday next Monday, August 3rd.

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead

angles.name: Bank Holiday Vibes
